newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to try for upside, must jump 102.65.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to try for upside, must jump 102.65.

text.p: The June Bund contract on LIFFE has the potential to push higher on Thursday, but must close above 102.65 for any move to the upside to be confirmed, technical analysts said.
"We're quite constructive on this market," said Chase technical analyst Guenter Redeker.

"Yesterday we got to 102.59, but failed to break the upper boundary of the ascending trend channel at 102.65. This is the third time we've tested it, and normally that third attempt should develop a break to the upside."
By 0714 GMT, the June Bund was down 0.05 at 102.45.
Redeker said any upside break had to be confirmed by a daily closing price above 102.65.
Above there, the market would aim for 102.89, then 103.20. The market hit a contract high of 103.16 on February 28.
On the downside, Bunds should find a fairly robust prop at 102.31, said Redeker.
"The 102.31 Elliott support is holding up, and even if that is broken, the big strategic support is at 102.03 and as long as that holds, the uptrend will remain intact," he said.
Redeker said he was running long positions from 100.55, with a stop at 102.01 and a longer term target of 106.00.
Tom Hobson, director of technical analysis at Merrill Lynch in London, was more sceptical of the Bund's chances of heading higher.
"In the Bunds we've seen an acceleration of buying," he told RFTV, but he added the market faced channel resistance at 102.55-60. "It's going to be very difficult to break that."
Hobson said he was "cautiously positive" on Bunds but said if they fell back below 102.25-30 he would be neutral to negative.
By 0728 GMT, September Euromarks were unchanged at 96.76.
